PAD.Program_Description_Short: Desktop AI Assistant for OpenAI, Gemini, Claude, Grok, DeepSeek, Ollama and more. Includes chat and agents, RAG, Skills, plugins and MCP, Python/OS tools, vision, image/video generation, Computer use, web access, files, voice and automation.
PAD.Program_Description_Long:
PyGPT is an open-source desktop AI assistant for OpenAI GPT-6/GPT-5, Google Gemini, Anthropic Claude, xAI Grok, DeepSeek, Perplexity / Sonar, HuggingFace, OpenAI-compatible APIs, and local Ollama models such as DeepSeek, Qwen, gpt-oss, Gemma, Mistral, Llama, and others. It combines chat and multi-agent workflows with RAG, Agent Skills, plugins and MCP, Python/OS execution, vision, image and video generation, Computer use, web access, file handling, voice, automation, and extensible tools.
Features - Desktop AI assistant for Linux, Windows and macOS, written in Python. - Chat, Chat with Agents, Realtime + audio, Research, Completion, Image and Video generation, Computer use, Experts, and legacy Agent/Autonomous modes. - Supports OpenAI GPT-6 Astra, GPT-5.6, GPT-4, Google Gemini, Anthropic Claude, xAI Grok, DeepSeek, Perplexity / Sonar, and local Ollama models such as DeepSeek, Qwen, gpt-oss, Gemma, Mistral, Llama, and others. - Integrated LlamaIndex RAG for files, webpages, external sources, images, audio/video, and conversation history. - Built-in vector stores, embeddings, file indexing, context indexing, and project-specific indexes. - Image generation with models such as gpt-image, Imagen, Gemini, Nano Banana, and Grok. - Video generation with models such as Veo and Sora. - Web search and retrieval with DuckDuckGo, Google, and Microsoft Bing. - Speech recognition and speech synthesis with multiple cloud and local providers. - Extensible plugin system for files, Python, web search, Google services, GitHub, Slack, Telegram, X/Twitter, MCP, and more. - Model Context Protocol (MCP) support with a built-in Connectors manager and imports from common Claude, Codex, OpenClaw, Cursor, VS Code, OpenCode, MCPorter, JSON, TOML, and YAML configurations. - Chat with Agents with primary-agent, orchestrator, and swarm workflows plus dynamically managed workers. - Project-specific AGENTS.md rules for Chat with Agents. - Portable SKILL.md-based Agent Skills with catalog browsing, GitHub/local import, enable/disable management, and on-demand loading. - Built-in Python/OS tool with Python, IPython, system-command execution, built-in sandbox, and Docker support. - Native and fallback vision support for image attachments, screenshots, and camera capture. - Computer use with supported OpenAI, Google, and Anthropic models. - Local and provider-side tools/function calls, custom commands, filesystem access, and external API integrations. - File and attachment handling with native upload, local processing, RAG, summaries, downloads, and project-aware workdirs. - Short- and long-term conversation memory with optional advanced context handling for long conversations. - Integrated calendar, day notes, conversation history, and @mentions for files, attachments, and previous chats. - Crontab / Task scheduler for automated prompts and tasks. - Reusable presets for models, prompts, RAG, tools, and workflow configuration. - Multiple profiles with separate settings, history, files, and import/export support. - Accessibility features including keyboard shortcuts, voice control, and spoken UI feedback. - Built-in Notepad, Painter, Indexer, media tools, text editor, browser, Python/OS, and Agent Workflow monitor. - Customizable themes, layouts, translations, and profile-level CSS/QSS overrides. - Real-time code syntax highlighting and token-usage estimates. - Fully configurable and extensible with custom models, providers, plugins, vector stores, loaders, and agents. - Open source and available on GitHub. - Uses your own provider API credentials; local models can run without external API keys.
The application is free and open source and runs on Linux, Windows 10/11, and macOS. Full Python source code is available on GitHub.
PyGPT uses your own API credentials for supported cloud providers. Local models, such as those served through Ollama, do not require external API credentials.
